# Integration cards

<!-- Generated by tools/card_index.py from the cards and index/records.jsonl. Do not edit by hand:
     run `python3 tools/card_index.py` after adding a card or rebuilding the index. -->

161 cards, one per repo: install, wiring, gotchas, license. Cards were read from source, docs and issues, not run, unless the card says so. Grouped by the repo's primary concept in the index; "Also" lists its other concepts. Fit is the index's hackathon fit. Last push is the GitHub API value stored in the index at build time, not a release date: check releases on GitHub before you pin a version. License is the card's License row, shortened; read the card for caveats.

Per-capability picks (default and alternative): [reference-stacks.md](../reference-stacks.md). Narrative notes per writing batch, with the top gotcha of each card: [index-flight-c2](_index-flight-c2.md), [index-gnss-fusion-gis](_index-gnss-fusion-gis.md), [index-perception-altnav](_index-perception-altnav.md), [index-round3](_index-round3.md), [index-round5-c2-gis](_index-round5-c2-gis.md), [index-round5-nav](_index-round5-nav.md).
